summary: Structured Obligations Corp filed an 8-K reporting a routine monthly distribution to holders of Select Notes Trust LT 2003-5 certificates. The filing discloses interest received ($116,250.00 total, $3.21398 per certificate) and a trustee's report for the June 15, 2026 distribution date. No M&A, tender, spin-off, restructuring, or other special situation is involved. This is a standard periodic remittance for an asset-backed security trust, not a corporate special event. The filing serves only as a Form 1099 information notice. There are no deal terms; the registrant is the issuer/trust administrator filing a routine current report.
